req.title: Emit Swagger UI
req.statement: The system shall serve interactive Swagger UI documentation at GET /docs.

doc.reasoning: R-PLAYER-018 requires GET /docs to serve interactive Swagger UI documentation with an HTTP 2xx response. Tests cover: (1) positive EP — valid GET /docs returns 200 with HTML content containing Swagger UI markers; (2) negative NEG — wrong HTTP method (POST) on /docs returns 405; (3) boundary BVA — exact status code 200 (not 201, not 199) and exact Content-Type header containing 'text/html'; (4) DT — verifying the response body contains specific Swagger UI identifiers to catch mutations that swap the docs endpoint or return wrong content. Mutation resilience is achieved by asserting exact status codes, exact content-type substrings, and exact HTML landmark strings present in the Swagger UI page.

tests.name: test_get_docs_returns_200_with_swagger_html
preconditions: GET /docs endpoint is registered by FastAPI automatically
expected: Response body contains 'swagger' (case-insensitive) indicating Swagger UI
trace: R-PLAYER-018: system shall serve interactive Swagger UI at GET /docs
Expected outcome: HTTP 2xx response with expected payload
tests.executable:
from main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

def test_get_docs_returns_200_with_swagger_html():
    client = TestClient(app)
    response = client.get('/docs')
    assert response.status_code == 200
    content_type = response.headers.get('content-type', '')
    assert 'text/html' in content_type
    body = response.text.lower()
    assert 'swagger' in body

test_get_docs_returns_200_with_swagger_html()
